Comfort & Distinction

Situated at Gurushankar Apartment, Plot No. 4B, Amravati Road, Tilak Nagar, Nagpur, Hotel Max Villa is crafted for discerning business executives, families, and leisure travelers who seek a tranquil haven in the heart of Maharashtra’s winter capital.

Whether you are visiting Nagpur for corporate engagements, educational visits near Nagpur University, or exploring the cultural landmarks like Deekshabhoomi and Futala Lake, our classic interiors, attentive staff, and peaceful ambiance ensure an unforgettable stay.
